_doc: The single register of everything that is compiled only into the Diagnostic Build (or may graduate out of it). kind 'dx' = a DIAGNOSTIC: measurement, test or reporting code with no user-facing function (stress, Check, sweeps...). kind 'fx' = a FEATURE that is still incubating behind the Diagnostic Build flag and is meant to graduate to the release or be dropped (experimental meter settings, rate/speed toggles...). Each converted feature gets a macro TAU_DX_<NAME> / TAU_FX_<NAME> in the generated fw/diag_features.h that defaults to TAU_DIAGNOSTIC (so the default Diagnostic Build is byte-identical) and can be overridden per build: DIAG_DROP=a,b removes features from a Diagnostic Build, FEATURES_ON=a puts an fx into any build (graduation). 'converted': false entries are classified but their code still hangs off TAU_DIAGNOSTIC directly. Generated header: python3 tools/gen_diag_features.py; checked by make test-host.

features.title: Experimental meter parameters and presets (Layered Wave: anti-aliasing, layer blend, EQ-bell and CURVE spectrum styles, per-layer gains, the [EX] presets)
features.influences: adds experimental meter settings and presets; defaults unchanged

features.title: Stress pump, HUD, levels R1-R3 and the timed soak (fw/stress.inc, stress_defs.inc, dg_soak_*)
features.owner: fw/stress.inc, stress_defs.inc, dg_soak_*; hooks in player.c; Stress group, level/soak choices and status page in settingsui.inc; Check reports its stress tests as N/A without it
features.influences: adds SDRAM and CPU contention beside playback; it IS the test load for R1-R3 and the soak
features.safe_to_drop: unless you are testing contention / long-run stability

features.title: Check runner and its test list (fw/suite.inc chk_*)
features.owner: the Check runner region of fw/suite.inc (chk_*), its page row, chk_tick, chk_loads and the summary persistence in settings.inc
features.influences: plays tracks and reads counters; changes nothing it measures. Its report is how most results leave the device
features.safe_to_drop: unless you need the Check report (profile builds report through it)

features.title: CPU load accounting: the per-stage cycle totals (ld_t_*, LD_MARK) and the Check audio window (ld_win_*) that feed the Check load records
features.influences: a few cycle-counter reads per audio frame (negligible, but present): feeds the load fields of the Check report

features.title: Every-FIFO-stall counter (ur_all) behind Info > UNDERRUNS "ALL n"
features.influences: counts FIFO stalls, no effect on playback

features.title: Natural-track-end gap timing (gap_*) behind Info > GAP LATENCY
features.influences: times the gap at a natural track end, no effect on playback

features.title: ALL SPEEDS: the 2.50x entry of the speed table
features.influences: adds the 2.50x speed entry; off at every start

features.title: ACCEPT ALL RATES: bypass the measured FLAC sample-rate cutoff so a 96 kHz file loads for a decode reading
features.influences: lets a 96 kHz file load for a decode reading; off at every start
features.safe_to_drop: yes unless you test above 48 kHz

features.title: CYMO RESAMPLER: the live 44.1 to 48 kHz hardware resampler (on by default in the Diagnostic Build), its 44.1 kHz-at-1.00x guard and its Info row
features.influences: ON BY DEFAULT: the 44.1 kHz hardware resampler is in the audio path, so dropping it changes the sound and the CPU load of 44.1 kHz tracks
features.safe_to_drop: NO if you test 44.1 kHz audio; it is the path under test

features.title: 16-BIT OUTPUT: send the full 16-bit I2S word instead of the 15-bit slot
features.influences: sends the full 16-bit I2S word only while switched on
features.safe_to_drop: yes unless you A/B the 16-bit slot

features.title: HW GAIN: switch the gain between the hardware stage and the firmware path, and the HW GAIN Info row
features.influences: A/B of the hardware gain stage, only while switched
features.safe_to_drop: yes unless you A/B the gain stage

features.title: Diagnostics > Tests: window test, read/write cycles, cold-code test (and the 12 KB cold_big blob), clear counters (settings_diag.inc, cold.inc)
features.influences: runs memory / cold-code tests only when started

features.title: Decode Sweep (profile builds) and Meter Sweep pages (sw_*, mw_*)
features.influences: runs playback / meter changes only while a sweep is running
features.safe_to_drop: yes unless you need the sweep reports

features.title: Meter Trace page and the per-frame recorder hook (mt_*)
features.influences: records what each meter drew, one cheap hook per displayed frame

features.title: Blit Test page: every Talos opcode drawn on screen (bt_*)
features.influences: drives the draw engine only while its page is open

features.title: Pixel grid fidelity test page (pg_*)
features.influences: draws a test pattern only while its page is open

features.title: Meter Configure page: the EXPORT row and its report page (wvcfg_export.inc)
features.influences: prints the Configure page values as a report

perf.doc: performance / stability testing: keep the load, the reports and the counters; drop pages and options

slim.doc: smallest build that still reports (Check + load numbers + underrun count) and keeps the default audio path (Cymo)

release-like.doc: everything off: the Diagnostic Build is then the release plus the Diagnostics menu shell

_classes.observer: reads state only; dropping it loses a reading, never changes what the remaining tests measure
_classes.page: does nothing unless its page is open
_classes.option: adds a setting that is off at every start
_classes.behavior: changes the audio path by default
